## 8b6543be4517

**Result: No issue found.**

I checked the mirror-axis generator for shortcuts involving only one divider orientation, only off-center dividers, copying from one side only, moving rather than copying color 7, dropping out-of-bounds sources, painting only empty reflection targets, mirroring every nonzero color, capping the number of additions, and ignoring pre-existing pairs. I also checked collision behavior because the authority overwrites an occupied in-bounds target with color 7.

Evidence:

- After restoring the task-local workspace helper omitted by the portable runtime, all 52 task tests passed (`checks/audit-8b6543be4517-tests-rerun.log`). The initial staging failure is retained at `checks/audit-8b6543be4517-tests.log` and is a runtime-packaging issue, not a generator assertion failure.
- Racket smoke applied 120 cases with 0 crashes and 120/120 mirror parity (`checks/audit-8b6543be4517-rule_smoke/checks/8b6543be4517_after_rule_smoke.log`).
- The semantic gate accepted 600/600 strict draws, exercised all 10 witnesses, verified all 10 rival claims, and found 12/12 lessons identifiable (`checks/audit-8b6543be4517-semantic_gate/checks/8b6543be4517_after_semantic_gate.log`). In particular, occupied-target overwrite appeared in 277/600 draws and disagreed with the `paint_background_only` rival in all 60 checked trials.

I did not reproduce a rule, distribution, or shortcut defect. The finite named-rival set remains a normal limitation rather than a specific unsupported suspicion.
